program: FINAL pre-execution literature survey for the v22 plan (14 Aug 2026): who has already claimed each mechanism the v22 plan relies on — the temporal branch (reservoir computing, delay-line memory, growing reservoirs), the integration layer (stacking/score fusion, classifier selection/competence routing), residual growth over fixed features, and the pruned-dense baseline? This survey ADJUDICATES CLAIM STATUS ONLY. It never supports a novelty claim (N95.6).

registration_notes.N95.1: This is the FINAL survey for RESEARCH_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v22. It covers the six v22 claim families that the M135 survey did NOT cover (M135 covered the seven image-construction directions: data axis, domain specialists, fixed code geometry, second-order pooling, scattering, shallow learned encoder, frontier-map framing). M135's adjudications are carried over verbatim into the final claim ledger; this survey only adds the new families.
registration_notes.N95.2: Question registered BEFORE search: for each of R1 reservoir computing/ESN, R2 delay-line/autoregressive memory, R3 growing/incremental reservoirs, R4 stacking/score fusion/classifier selection, R5 boosting over fixed base learners, R6 pruned-dense baselines — who already claims it, at what level (mechanism / benchmark / research program), and what therefore remains for this programme (sealed matched-cost measurement only).
registration_notes.N95.3: Anchors are recall probes: each MUST be retrieved by a topic query that does NOT contain its title, else the search is insensitive and every 'not found' is worthless.
registration_notes.N95.4: Query families are phrased to find displacing work (work that already measures or builds the mechanism), not work that merely agrees in spirit.
registration_notes.N95.5: Empty queries are recorded, not dropped. Rate-limited queries are retried and residual failures recorded separately from genuinely empty results.
registration_notes.N95.6: Absence from these indexes is UNRESOLVED, never 'new' or 'first'. Unauthenticated public search cannot support a novelty claim.
registration_notes.N95.7: Title/abstract mark a source live; only primary text with a located passage may count as displacement.
registration_notes.N95.8: This evidence is a dated snapshot and is NOT replayable: the indexes change and the network is not a sealed corpus. The run records its date and the exact query strings so a reader can repeat the search, not so the bytes can be reproduced.
registration_notes.N95.9: Instrument reused from M127/M129/M132/M135 (audit_v13_prior_art): arXiv two-stage AND-then-OR, Semantic Scholar with retry; S2 rate-limiting recorded as failures, not empty. The local query-result cache (N94.11) is reused; failures are never cached.
registration_notes.N95.10: Positive-control probes pair papers whose existence is not in doubt with topic queries that omit their titles. Probe failures are reported per family; a family whose probe failed cannot be searched for absence.
registration_notes.N95.11: Carried-over M135 adjudications (D1-D7) are NOT re-run here; their queries are served from the cache when shared, and the final ledger cites M135's evidence file directly.
registration_notes.N95.12: Adjudication output: analysis/PRIOR_ART_V22_FINAL.md — a claim-status ledger for every v22 mechanism (carried M135 rows + new R1-R6 rows), written only after this run completes.

R1.statement: Reservoir computing / echo state networks — a fixed random recurrent reservoir with a closed-form ridge readout — is already claimed: the construction, the echo-state property, memory capacity, and ridge readouts are established (Jaeger 2001/2007; Maass LSM 2002).
queries: echo state network ridge regression readout
reservoir computing random recurrent neural network
reservoir computing time series prediction benchmark
deep echo state network stacked reservoirs

R2.statement: Delay-line / autoregressive memory for sequence prediction — tap-delay lines, time-delay embeddings, NARX autoregressive-exogenous models, TDNNs — is classical, already claimed.
queries: time delay embedding nonlinear time series prediction
time delay neural network sequential processing
autoregressive linear model time series prediction

R3.statement: Growing / incremental reservoirs — appending reservoir neurons over time, growing ESNs — is already claimed.
queries: growing echo state network incremental reservoir

R4.statement: Late fusion / score-level fusion / stacking, and competence-based classifier selection — the v22 integration layer — are already claimed.

R5.statement: Residual/greedy growth over fixed base learners — boosting, including boosting of random features — is already claimed.
queries: gradient boosting additive model weak learners

R6.statement: Pruned-dense baselines — structured pruning, magnitude pruning, lottery tickets, and pruned-vs-efficient trade-offs — are already claimed.
